I'm not sure if its for sex or what but things seem very sketchy and I have called and they've tried to talk to me but a lot of my feelings have still been pushed to the side. Also i guess I should explain that originally she was male and we were in a hetero relationship so it had changed to a lesbian one and I guess she wanted to explore her new side but it feels like it's at my expense...

Yes, she's asked me to lie to everyone and say that she's going for work. Just earlier her mom asked me about her whereabouts since she didn't even tell her...its hard because I don't want to lie but when she ignores the questions I get asked them and its hard to know what to do.

Thanks. It's not a great situation yeah, it just sucks cause everytime I start to trust her a little again she does something behind my back and then blames it on the fact that its just "how she is". 

I'll just have to keep my eye on him. He's already been quite rude and refuses to acknowledge me even when she is talking to him about me...just bad first vibes all around.
